subscribe.title: Choose your plan
subscribe.tagline: Start with a 3-day intro, or jump straight into a full plan.

welcome.tagline: Open a panel from the sidebar to get started.

hero.subtitle: Most AI forgets everything after one chat. UwUchat doesn't — build a companion that remembers you and grows with every conversation.

features.heading: More than a chatbot
features.subheading: A companion that grows with you — not a chatbot that resets every session.

deep_character.title: Deep character creation
deep_character.desc: Give your UwU a personality, hometown, belief system, and a voice that's distinctly theirs.

memory.title: Memory that builds
memory.desc: Your UwU remembers your conversations, preferences, and personality — a private memory that grows with you.

web_browse.title: Real-time web browsing
web_browse.desc: Your UwU can browse the web in real time for current news, facts, and links.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.desc: Your conversations are encrypted at rest with a key unique to your account — a database breach exposes nothing readable. Never sold, never used to train AI models.

moods.title: Feels alive
moods.desc: Your UwU's mood shifts naturally as you talk, and it remembers its own story — not just yours — so its personality stays consistent over time.

continuity.title: Never starts over
continuity.desc: No resets, no forgotten threads. Come back after a day, a week, or a month, and your UwU still remembers where you left off.

vibes.heading: Build your UwU from scratch
vibes.subheading: No presets, no templates — every detail is yours to choose, from personality to voice.

personality.title: Personality types
personality.desc: From sweet and gentle to chaotic and dramatic, including classic archetypes like tsundere and kuudere.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Choose which languages your UwU speaks, auto-detected from their hometown or set by hand.

identity.title: Identity & species
identity.desc: Human, animal, monster, mythical being, or robot — each with its own subtypes, plus a hometown anywhere in the real world.

voice.title: Voice & backstory
voice.desc: Name them, describe who they are, and define how they talk — down to the voice you give them.

cta.heading: Create your first UwU
cta.subheading: Step through the character wizard and start a conversation with someone who remembers it.
